notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Sheet 'c' is the white edge and 'd' the edge + border (read as AS 1743 does: 10/30 = edge 10 + border 20, 5/15 = 5 + 10, 15/45 = 15 + 30), confirmed against the national R-series pairs. Q-series sheet R4-040-Q08 'Speed limit for personal mobility devices' (2025), one size: 300 x 500, R25, 5 / 15 (edge 5 + border 10). Chain 35 / 200 (red annulus, outer dia 200; inner dia 166 read from the sheet's vector ring, r 100 / 83) / 30 / 200 (e-scooter symbol, 200 square, centred x 50-250) / 35 = 500: annulus centre (150, 135), numerals 80D centred in it (cap top 95, as the R4-1 rule), symbol y 265-465. E-scooter: the sheet's own vector path (tools/symbols/qld_r4-040-q08_escooter.svg). Speed 'insert appropriate' (25 shown in the example): 10, 12 and 25 generated, the personal mobility device limits of the Queensland road rules (12 on footpaths, 25 on paths and roads, 10 in shared zones) (Russell: the variants that make sense, not every value). Red and black on white.
